a.summary:
Designer A removes the off-trajectory screen, the 1000-attempt trial, the max_steps/2 split and the n<=10 limit. An undeclared request starts DOPRI5 in its persistent session (one attempt per advance). Pilots are armed at doubling times b*2^k of DOPRI5's attempts (b = break-even length) and at a witness taken from DOPRI5's own stages (q<0 and |R_DOPRI5(z)|>=1, no threshold). Once DOPRI5 has spent at least one RODAS5P attempt's cost since the anchor, one RODAS5P attempt replays exactly that interval (existing bounded solve, max_steps=1). RODAS5P takes over from DOPRI5's frontier only if that attempt was cheaper in callbacks, operations and attempts. This Pareto test uses no exchange rate. Pilot spend never exceeds DOPRI5's committed spend.

Without any model: cost <= 2*C_D when there is no handover; no callback before DOPRI5's first stage; one shared max_steps; deterministic on one host.

Under a piecewise-rate model:
- stiff from t0: C_R + b*c_D + c_R
- one late onset: <= 2*min(C_D,C_R) + O(b*c_D) + pilots, about min + O(c_R) when a witness marks the onset
- non-stiff: C_D + O(log) lost pilots

Numbers that remain: doubling base 2 (convention), ski-rental ratio 1, flop and tableau counts, DOPRI5's stability polynomial. Kept rules: strategy, declared regime, admission, supplied derivative starts RODAS5P, one-way handover. No protected file changes. Owner decisions D1-D7 are listed.

a.algorithm:
Declared facts first (unchanged rules, no callback): RobustStiff or regime Stiff -> RODAS5P; AdaptiveReentrant -> switching adapter; DOPRI5 not admitted -> RODAS5P; regime Nonstiff -> DOPRI5 alone; supplied Jacobian/JVP/band -> RODAS5P; RODAS5P refuses -> Err before any callback.

Otherwise BREAK_EVEN. Per-attempt cost vectors in (callbacks, operations, attempts):
- c_R = (n+9 [+2 if non-autonomous without f_t], 2n^3/3 + 18n^2 + 128n, 1)
- c_D = (6, 52n, 1)
- b = max over units of ceil(c_R/c_D) (b = 4 for n=3, 7 for n=8, 78 for n=64, ~n^2/78 for large n)

DOPRI5 runs in its persistent session with quota-1 advances; S = committed DOPRI5 cost, P = pilot cost. Pilot 0 is armed at (t0, y0). Later anchors are DOPRI5's current accepted state, set at most once per doubling interval [b*2^k, b*2^(k+1)) as a tenure pilot (from 2b on), and at most once per interval at the first witness.

Witness: from the attempt's own stages, q = h<d,g>/<d,d>, rho = h|g|/|d|, d = Y7-Y6, g = k7-k6, z = q + i*sqrt(rho^2-q^2). It fires iff q<0 and |R(z)|>=1 with R(z) = sum_{k<=5} z^k/k! + z^6/600.

An armed pilot fires when the matched DOPRI5 cost M on [a, t_D] reaches c_R in every unit, P + c_R <= S, and an attempt is left. If DOPRI5 made no progress, M = spent + c_D and h = DOPRI5's first trial step from a. The pilot is Rodas5p::solve_observed_bounded on (a, a+h) from y_a with h0 = h, max_steps = 1. Its state is never committed. If the attempt was accepted and its cost is below M in every unit, hand over: the RODAS5P leg runs from DOPRI5's frontier (t_D, y_D) with the user's options and the attempts left (one-way). A fatal callback inside a pilot loses the pilot, is recorded, and DOPRI5 continues (D2). A numerical DOPRI5 stop with attempts left -> RODAS5P from the last accepted state; exhausting the shared max_steps -> typed MaxStepsReached.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: doubling base of pilot times
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Geometric spacing is needed to keep the pilot count logarithmic and the detection delay proportional to the work done. Base beta gives a delay <= (beta-1)*A(t_s) and log_beta pilots. No theorem fixes beta for this cost structure; 2 is the textbook doubling, not fitted.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: ski-rental balance
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Break-even point of the ski-rental argument; it makes the 2*C_D bound unconditional. A ratio theta gives (1+theta)*C_D.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: one tenure pilot and one witness pilot per doubling interval
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Bounds the cost of false witnesses (non-normal or badly scaled problems) by the same logarithm.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Jacobian callback = n callback units
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Needed to place an analytic Jacobian on the callback axis; it is the facade guard's own charging (solve.rs:251-255), equal to the finite-difference replacement.

remaining_hyperparameters.why: The operation axis needs a count; textbook values. Pareto dominance in callbacks and operations avoids any RHS-cost exchange rate, which is not observable without timing.

properties: U1 ski-rental balance (unconditional): a pilot fires only if P + c_R <= S, so pilot spend never exceeds committed DOPRI5 spend. Without a handover, cost = C_D + P <= 2*C_D in every unit, with at most 2*log2(A_D/b)+4 pilots. 'S = C_D' requires the session to equal Dopri5::solve bit for bit; E4 checks it.

U2: a handover happens only after one RODAS5P attempt covered exactly the interval DOPRI5 had covered from the same accepted state (or one DOPRI5 could not pass), at a lower cost in callbacks, operations and attempts.
U3: DOPRI5, pilot and RODAS5P attempts share one max_steps, enforced with quota-1 advances.
U4: no user callback before DOPRI5's first stage. Off-trajectory evaluations occur only inside pilots (FD probes and stages from accepted DOPRI5 states) or in the RODAS5P leg.

U5: deterministic. Decisions use integer counters, deterministically computed f64 values (trial steps, accepted times, secant pair) and the accept/reject of a deterministic RODAS5P attempt; no clock, thread or random seed. Same route and bits on the same host; across hosts the FMA/libm differences any adaptive driver has, so Auto goldens are host-pinned.
Lemma (model M: piecewise-constant rates, RODAS5P accepts h iff h <= h_R in the phase): a pilot hands over iff RODAS5P is cheaper per unit time in every unit in the current phase.
B1 stiff from t0: cost <= C_R + b*c_D + c_R.
B2 one onset at t_s: cost <= 2*min(C_D,C_R) + 2b*c_D + P without any witness. With a timely witness (assumption W): <= min(C_D,C_R) + 3b*c_D + P. Today's worst observed ratio is ~15.
B3 non-stiff: every pilot loses; cost = C_D + P with P = O(log(A_D/b)) * c_R.
B4 limits: one-way (later DOPRI5-favourable phases are paid at RODAS5P's rate); a short RODAS5P-favourable window between doubling times can be missed, still capped by U1.
Units: callbacks, operations and attempts, compared by Pareto dominance (valid for every RHS-cost exchange rate kappa >= 0); no tuned conversion. A declared kappa is optional.

Witness: parameter-free, from DOPRI5's own stages; it only schedules pilots and never decides. Exact constants: real boundary 3.3065678926 (R=+1 there, not -1 as dopri5_stiffness.rs:17-18 says), imaginary 0.99718900863.

b.summary: Design B replaces the t0 stiffness screen, the dimension limit 10, the trial budget min(1000, max_steps/2) and the supplied-derivative rule with a route that compares measured costs. Each run is charged in two deterministic currencies: callback units CB (RHS incl. finite-difference columns, ft, JVP, a user Jacobian priced as n calls) and arithmetic operations OP (factorizations, solves, Krylov and stage vector work). The true cost is kappa*CB+OP for an unknown price kappa. One comparison rule covers every decision. With a declared price, costs are compared at that price. Otherwise A>=B iff A_cb*A_op >= B_cb*B_op, the minimax ratio-regret choice over kappa in [0,inf). Its worst loss, Gamma, is structural (<=1.42 for dense n<=10 and banded problems) and is reported. The incumbent runs: DOPRI5 first, or RODAS5P first when a derivative is supplied. When its spend reaches a probe's cost (break-even, then doubling after each losing probe), the other method takes committed steps from the accepted state until its controller saturates, plus one measuring step. The cheaper steady rate continues. While RODAS5P holds a Jacobian, |tr J|/n and the DOPRI5 region radius 3.9785 exclude futile DOPRI5 probes at no callback cost. Under a stated rate model: cost <= Gamma*(better single method + probes) in one regime, and <= 2*Gamma*(best one-switch schedule) + probes across one regime change. Today's route has no relative bound (15x on Robertson). The route is deterministic, makes no routing-only callbacks and needs no replay. One tunable remains: doubling base 2. Owner decisions: the start rule for finite-difference problems, and a fatal error at a probe's FD column.

b.algorithm:
Declared rules first, unchanged: strategy RobustStiff -> RODAS5P; AdaptiveReentrant -> switching adapter; regime Stiff -> RODAS5P; DOPRI5 not admitted -> RODAS5P; regime Nonstiff -> DOPRI5. Both entry points are validated before any callback.
Measured-cost route:
  price := Unknown | Declared(kappa) | Measured(opt-in)
  compare(A,B) := kappa*A_cb+A_op vs kappa*B_cb+B_op (declared); A_cb*A_op vs B_cb*B_op (unknown: minimax ratio regret over kappa in [0,inf), worst loss Gamma reported)
  m := RODAS5P if a Jacobian/JVP/sparse JVP is supplied, else DOPRI5; c := other; seeds := h0
  P[c] := a-priori one-attempt cost from structural facts; T := P[c]
  loop (session, one attempt at a time, all charged to max_steps):
    attempt of m from the accepted (t,y); U += cost; record saturation (factor below max_factor cap, or previous attempt rejected)
    fatal/malformed callback -> STOP CallbackFailed; budget used -> STOP MaxStepsReached; t==t1 -> done
    if m stopped numerically: PROBE(c) forced
    elif m saturated and U >= T and not SKIP(c): PROBE(c)
    PROBE(c): committed attempts of c from (t,y) (seed: c's carried proposal, else max(h0,seed[m]) for RODAS5P, min(h0,seed[m]) for DOPRI5) until the first saturated accepted attempt, plus one measuring attempt; steady rate = cost of the measuring step / h; P[c] := probe cost
    if m failed or rate(m) > rate(c): swap m,c; new tenure, T := P[new c]
    else: T := U + componentwise_max(U, P[c])  (spend since probe >= max(spend before it, its cost): break-even + doubling); m resumes from the probe end
  SKIP(c): horizon (P[c] >= rate(m)*(t1-t)); exclusion when c=DOPRI5 and RODAS5P stores J: rho_lb=|tr J|/n, h_max=3.9785/rho_lb, E_lb=(6, v_E)/h_max; skip iff E_lb >= rate(RODAS5P) in both currencies (or at the declared price). A skipped probe leaves T unchanged and is re-checked after the next accepted attempt.
Evidence: counters, accepted step sizes, controller cap state, RODAS5P's stored Jacobian, all on the route's own trajectory. Callbacks: only attempts of DOPRI5/RODAS5P from accepted states. The only non-stage points are RODAS5P's FD columns and FD time derivative (as direct RODAS5P). Nothing is replayed or rolled back.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Doubling base of probe thresholds (T := U + max(U,P))
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Trade-off between late detection of a regime change (factor b) and number of losing probes (log_b); no scale-free optimum. Any b>1 keeps the bound form. In a simple model the minimax base is 1.61 (worst 2.38 vs 2.53 at b=2, 3.33 at b=3): weakly sensitive.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: r_max, largest modulus of the DOPRI5 stability region
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Needed by the trace exclusion; follows from R(z)=sum_{k<=5} z^k/k! + z^6/600 of the tableau. Removable only by dropping the exclusion (then O(log) futile DOPRI5 probes in long stiff runs).

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Operation counts (DOPRI5 ~56n vector ops/attempt, RODAS5P ~116n+n^2+n; dense LU (2/3)n^3, solve 2n^2)
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Put each method's own arithmetic into the OP currency; exact once the drivers count them.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Price of a user Jacobian (n calls), JVP and time derivative (1 call)
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Puts user-Jacobian builds in the callback currency. Repository convention for work ceilings (solve.rs:252-255) and the price of the FD Jacobian it replaces. A separate price makes comparisons degenerate, since DOPRI5 builds none.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Finite-difference increment sqrt(eps)*max(|y_j|,1)
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Part of RODAS5P's own FD Jacobian (fd.rs:441-455); no longer used by the router.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Driver controller constants (safety 0.9, factors 0.2/5/0.9, min_step 1e-14)
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Changing controller constants is not authorized (PROGRESS.md:75); the saturation test reads max_factor but adds no number.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: One measuring step after saturation
remaining_hyperparameters.why: A steady rate needs at least one step at the located step-size limit.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Rules without numbers (product rule, ties keep incumbent, start rule, fatal terminal, numerical stop forces probe, horizon rule, exclusion rule, probe seeds)
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Structural decisions; the start rule and the fatal-at-FD-column rule are offered to the owner with alternatives.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: User inputs: rtol, atol, h0, max_steps, rhs_price, regime, strategy
remaining_hyperparameters.why: The user's tolerances, budget and knowledge, not hyperparameters of the route.

properties: Cost bound, one regime, declared price (model M: additive costs, method-independent trajectory, saturated probes measure steady rates): C_auto <= min(C_E,C_I) + P*(3+log2(min(C_E,C_I)/P_min)). Probes need doubling spend, so there are at most 1+log2(C/P_min) losing probes; a wrong start costs at most the break-even spend.

Cost bound, one change of regime (Robertson type), declared price: C_auto <= 2*C_1 + P*(4+log2(C_1/P_min)), with C_1 = best one-switch schedule <= min(C_E,C_I). The delay after the change is at most the incumbent's spend before it (threshold rule T := U + max(U,P)).

Unknown price: every comparison loses at most its Gamma = sqrt(ratio spread of the two currencies) against the true-price decision. The bounds hold with costs scaled by Gamma_max: <=1.42 for dense n<=10 and banded problems, ~sqrt(n/14) for large dense problems. Gamma and the break-even price kappa* are reported per decision.

Trace exclusion is regret-free under the linearization: |tr J|/n <= spectral radius for any matrix, so DOPRI5 needs h <= 3.9785*n/|tr J|. A skipped probe is one DOPRI5 cannot win at any price. If the model fails, the error is one-sided toward RODAS5P (the protected method).

Today's route has no relative bound: 15x on Robertson without J (REVIEW F8). Non-stiff problems the screen flags (oscillatory, non-normal) and non-stiff problems with a supplied J run RODAS5P for the whole span.

Determinism: decisions use only integer counters (compared in exact u128), accepted step sizes and stored Jacobian entries. No clock, threads, hash order or thread-local state. Same host and inputs give the same route and bits. Measured price is opt-in, recorded, and replayable bit for bit by declaring the recorded kappa (FFTW MEASURE/wisdom pattern).

No routing-only callbacks. Every call belongs to a committed DOPRI5/RODAS5P attempt from an accepted state. The only non-stage points are RODAS5P's FD columns/FD time derivative, exactly what direct RODAS5P makes there. None exist with a supplied derivative. REVIEW F2 case completes.
No replay requirement (each interval is integrated once; probes are committed), unlike the switching adapter's same-window comparators.

Neutrality: a solve without probes is bit-identical to the direct call of its method, given sessions that reproduce the native step sequence. Examples: stiff with a supplied matrix J (all DOPRI5 probes excluded); short non-stiff runs where the horizon rule skips probes.

Budget: one shared max_steps, probes charged, typed MaxStepsReached with the accepted prefix, no reserved trial share; the loop terminates (thresholds grow geometrically or a committed probe swaps the methods).

scenarios.behavior: With a supplied matrix J (P_heat_dense, P_scalar_dense): RODAS5P starts. After saturation, DOPRI5 is excluded at every check (heat n=64: |trJ|/n=8450, E_lb ~(1.3e4,7.6e6) vs RODAS5P ~(288,1.0e6) per unit time; scalar trJ=-1e6). Result = direct RODAS5P (328 and 48 RHS, as today). With FD (P_scalar_fd, P_heat_fd): DOPRI5 starts and pays the break-even prefix. The RODAS5P probe wins once its step exceeds DOPRI5's by sqrt((CB_I/CB_E)(OP_I/OP_E)) (~3.9 at n=8). Estimate ~100-125 RHS vs 74 today, and 800-1100 vs 723. V03b work bounds hold; the V03b assertion 'no DOPRI5 leg' does not (owner question).

No J: DOPRI5 starts (trJ=-0.04 at t0). RODAS5P is probed at doubling spends and wins when its step is ~2.5x DOPRI5's (n=3), estimate after 20-40 DOPRI5 attempts. One to three later DOPRI5 probes lose; then |trJ|/3 ~700 excludes DOPRI5. Estimate 600-800 RHS vs 415 direct RODAS5P and 6233 today (span 40): ~1.5-2x instead of 15x. With dense J: RODAS5P starts; at most a short DOPRI5 tenure in the early transient.

DOPRI5 runs. RODAS5P probes at break-even then doubling: at most 1+log2(C_E/P_I) probes of 1-2 RODAS5P steps each (<1% on long runs); the horizon rule skips probes that cannot pay off. A very short run may pay one losing probe (~one RODAS5P step).

scenarios.scenario: Oscillatory non-stiff (eigenvalues near the imaginary axis)
scenarios.behavior: DOPRI5's imaginary stability reach is |h omega|<=0.997, but accuracy already needs smaller steps. DOPRI5 is accuracy-limited and RODAS5P probes lose; trJ~0, so no wrong exclusion. Today the screen sends omega*(t1-t0) > 3.3B to RODAS5P for the whole span.

Non-stiff J=[[-1,1e4],[0,-2]]: today L~1e4 sends spans >0.33 to RODAS5P; here DOPRI5 runs and probes lose. Stiff non-normal [[-1e4,1e6],[0,-1e3]]: RODAS5P wins the first probes and trJ=-1.1e4 excludes DOPRI5. No norm decides; the trace bound holds for any matrix.

scenarios.scenario: Fatal callback error off the trajectory
scenarios.behavior: No routing call exists. REVIEW F2 (fatal for y>1, y0=1) completes like direct DOPRI5: the first RODAS5P probe comes after y<1, so the columns lie inside the domain. A fatal error exactly at a probe's FD column ends the solve (rule kept); the stop names the probe and column, the same call direct RODAS5P would make. With a supplied derivative no such point exists. Owner option: treat it as a failed probe.

One max_steps for all runs including probes; typed MaxStepsReached{max_steps} with the accepted prefix and all work; no trial share. Robertson max_steps=500: estimate ~60 DOPRI5+probe attempts, then RODAS5P, success. Tiny budgets stop where they end.

scenarios.scenario: Supplied Jacobian on a non-stiff problem
scenarios.behavior: RODAS5P takes one ramp (J at the accepted state, no FD point). DOPRI5 is then probed (not excluded, trJ small) and wins; DOPRI5 continues with O(log) RODAS5P probes. Today: RODAS5P for the whole span unless regime(Nonstiff) is declared.

scenarios.scenario: Large n with a cheap right-hand side
scenarios.behavior: Dense: Gamma grows ~sqrt(n/14) (8.5 at n=1000). Without a price, RODAS5P needs a step advantage ~1430 at n=1000 dense FD, since a dense factorization costs as much as many nearly-free RHS steps. With a band, Gamma~1.24 and the needed advantage is ~2.5. The record advises declaring the price or the structure. Today: n>10 always runs RODAS5P with a dense FD Jacobian.

scenarios.scenario: Small n with an expensive right-hand side
scenarios.behavior: Callbacks dominate. For n<=10, Gamma<=1.42, so the unknown-price decision is within 1.42 of the true-price decision; a declared price makes it exact. RODAS5P's n+1 FD columns per attempt are charged as what they cost. Today the screen spends n+1 expensive calls at t0 on every such request.

Tolerances (1e-6,1e-9), (1e-4,1e-7), (1e-8,1e-11).
MEASURES: CB and OP as defined; RHS incl. FD, user J builds, FD builds, JVPs, factorizations, solves; attempts accepted/rejected; runs, probes, switches; decision/exclusion records (Gamma, kappa*); achieved error at t1 vs a reference (analytic or RODAS5P rtol 1e-12); status/stop; callback entries counted in the user closures; final-state bits of 3 repeated runs. Cost at price kappa in {0, n, 10n, 100n, inf} = kappa*CB+OP; R(arm) = cost(arm)/min(cost(R_E), cost(R_I)).
DISCRIMINATORS (comparisons; 3 and the V03b bounds are existing frozen values):
D1 max over cases R(A1) <= max R(A0), at every price.
D2 geometric mean R(A1) <= that of A0, at every price.
D3 R(A1) < R(A0) on every Robertson case without J.
D4 cost(A1) <= cost(A0) at every price on the non-stiff set (P_oscillator span 1000, N3, N5, N6, N7, N14).
D5 every A1 run satisfies its own Proposition 1-3 bound computed from its record; one violation refutes the analysis.
D6 callback entries equal the calls of recorded attempts (no routing-only call), and N1 succeeds like R_E.
D7 3 runs give identical route, counters and bits.
D8 attempts <= max_steps; typed MaxStepsReached with prefix.
D9 error(A1) <= 3*max(error(R_E), error(R_I)) (A-gate factor of addendum A6).
D10 V03b guards: bounded-work thresholds PREDECLARED.json:46, P_fatal CallbackFailed{Rhs,'sensor offline'}, no second method after a fatal callback.
D11 an A1 run without probes is bit-identical to the direct call of its method.
EXPECTED LOSSES declared in advance: P_heat_fd and P_scalar_fd under A1 (DOPRI5 prefix, within D5); very short non-stiff runs that pay one losing probe. A1-I is expected to remove the first loss and to pay n+1 FD calls at t0 plus one RODAS5P step on every non-stiff FD request.
REFUTATION: D1, D5, D6, D7 or D8 fails -> design refuted. D3 or D4 fails -> economic claim refuted. D2 fails with D1 holding -> report a worst-case/average trade-off.
risks: Start rule for FD problems: DOPRI5-first avoids off-trajectory calls but makes stiff-from-t0 FD problems pay a bounded DOPRI5 prefix (estimate up to ~1.7x today on P_heat_fd/P_scalar_fd). It breaks the V03b assertions 'no DOPRI5 leg' for those two problems; the owner must choose this or RODAS5P-first (A1-I).
Fatal error at a probe's FD column stays terminal. Treating it as a failed probe would change the callback contract; owner decision.

Model M (rates measured exactly by one saturated step, regimes longer than a probe, linearized stability for the exclusion) is an idealization. Noisy rates near the DOPRI5 stability limit and very short regimes (Van der Pol) weaken the bounds; D5 checks every run against its own bound.

Without a declared price, large dense problems have large Gamma (~8.5 at n=1000), so the route may keep DOPRI5 where RODAS5P is cheaper for an expensive RHS, or vice versa. Users should declare rhs_price or a band.

Driver work: RODAS5P sessions exist only for dense explicit J (rodas5p_fast.rs:2800-2809); banded/matrix-free sessions must be written. The interim per-attempt bounded-leg fallback rebuilds J after each rejection.
The Measured price mode breaks run-to-run bit identity unless the recorded price is replayed; it should stay opt-in or be dropped.
Removing public screen constants and RouteBasis values is source-breaking for external callers.
The doubling base 2 is a convention (weakly sensitive: worst-case model ratio 2.38 at 1.61 vs 2.53 at 2).
Estimates in the document are hand estimates from V03b records, not measurements; the evaluation must replace them before any adoption claim.

judge.summary: Judge of V27. Designs A and B share a sound core: break-even pilots, doubling, one shared budget, no probe at t0. Each has a defect. I checked them with a Python model of both drivers (judge_model.py) that reproduces 8 V03b counts exactly. A anchors pilot 0 at t0, so DOPRI5's growth ramp from h0 makes one RODAS5P step look cheap. A then hands non-stiff problems to RODAS5P (oscillator span 1: 2.05x DOPRI5; Lotka-Volterra at rtol 1e-3: 3.3x), which refutes its claim B3. Its witness adds nothing. B's product rule lowers the threshold and lets phase-lucky single RODAS5P steps win: 6 false handovers in 27 non-stiff runs. B's plan also edits protected drivers (sessions, Jacobian trace, op counters) without saying so. Recommended design: forward break-even pilots (FBP). DOPRI5 runs in its session. Once DOPRI5 has located its step size, at DOPRI5 attempts >= b, 2b, 4b, ..., one RODAS5P attempt from DOPRI5's accepted state tries to cover the length of DOPRI5's last b attempts. If it is accepted, the step is kept and RODAS5P continues (one-way); otherwise the attempt is lost. b is the smallest integer with c_R <= b*c_D in callbacks and operations (dominance). In the model: geometric mean 0.56/0.47 of today's cost; worst ratio to the better single method 2.0 (today 25.6); Robertson 6233 -> 385 calls. One number remains: the doubling base 2. No protected file changes.
judge.recommended: FBP (forward break-even pilots). The declared rules are unchanged: strategy, regime, admission, and a supplied Jacobian/JVP/band starts RODAS5P. Every other request (finite differences, any n) starts DOPRI5 in its persistent session, one attempt per advance, with the shared budget max_steps. DOPRI5 attempts count only after DOPRI5 has located its step, meaning its first accepted attempt that was not growth-capped (factor < max_factor) or that followed a rejection. When the DOPRI5 attempt count first reaches each of b, 2b, 4b, ... and at least b located attempts exist, H is set to the length DOPRI5 advanced in its last b attempts. If DOPRI5 made no progress, H is the step it tried. When t1 - t_D <= H, pilots stop (horizon). Otherwise one RODAS5P attempt runs from DOPRI5's current accepted state with step H (Rodas5p::solve_observed_bounded, max_steps = 1), charged. If it is accepted, the step is kept and RODAS5P continues to t1 from there with h0 = H (one-way). If it is rejected, it is lost and the DOPRI5 session continues bit-identically. A fatal callback in a pilot ends the solve (owner decision D1). A numerical DOPRI5 stop hands over to RODAS5P as today. b = max over units of ceil(c_R/c_D) = ceil((2n^2+54n+384)/156), where c_D = (6, 52n) and c_R = (n+9[+2], 2n^3/3+18n^2+128n): b = 3, 4, 4, 7, 8, 78 for n = 1, 2, 3, 8, 10, 64.
judge.korean_summary:
무엇이 바뀌나: 아무것도 선언하지 않은 유한차분 요청은 차원과 관계없이 DOPRI5로 시작한다. t0에서 궤적 밖 점을 부르는 screen(n+1회), 차원 한계 10, trial 예산 min(1000, max_steps/2), 기준 3.3 B를 모두 없앤다. 대신 DOPRI5가 자기 보폭을 찾은 뒤(처음의 기각 탐색과 5배씩 키우는 구간은 세지 않음) DOPRI5 시도 수가 b, 2b, 4b, …에 이를 때마다 한 번, "DOPRI5가 최근 b회 시도로 전진한 길이 H를 RODAS5P가 지금 상태에서 한 번의 시도로 덮는가"를 묻는다. 덮으면 그 걸음을 그대로 채택하고 RODAS5P가 끝까지 간다(되돌아가지 않음). 못 덮으면 그 한 시도만 버리고 DOPRI5는 아무 영향 없이 계속한다. b는 RODAS5P 한 시도의 비용이 DOPRI5 b회 시도의 비용을 호출 수와 연산 수 모두에서 넘지 않는 가장 작은 정수로, n과 tableau에서 계산된다(n=1: 3, n=2~3: 4, n=8: 7, n=64: 78).

두 설계안의 판정: 공통 핵심(손익분기 pilot, 2배 간격, 하나의 공유 예산, t0 탐침 없음)은 맞다. A안은 pilot 0을 t0에 묶어 DOPRI5의 초기 보폭 증가 구간과 비교하므로 비강성 문제를 RODAS5P로 잘못 넘긴다(모형: 진동자 구간 1에서 DOPRI5의 2.05배, Lotka-Volterra 느슨한 허용오차에서 3.3배). B안의 곱 규칙은 b를 낮춰 한 걸음 측정의 잡음에 약하고(모형: 비강성 27회 중 6회 잘못 넘김), 구현에 보호 파일 수정이 필요한데 이를 밝히지 않았다. 권고안은 A의 한-시도 시험과 지배 비교, B의 "보폭을 찾은 뒤에만 잰다"와 앞으로만 가는 커밋을 합친 것이다.

모형 결과(레포 tableau와 제어기 상수로 만든 Python 모형, V03b 수치 8개를 정확히 재현): 기본 허용오차 22문제에서 오늘 경로 대비 비용의 기하평균 0.56(호출), 0.47(연산). 더 나은 단일 방법 대비 최악 비율 25.6배/54배 → 2.0배/1.9배. Robertson(FD, 구간 40) 6233 → 385회, Van der Pol μ=1000 5698 → 292회, Lorenz-96(n=40) 33467 → 3233회. 손해: screen이 잡던 t0부터 강성인 FD 문제(스칼라 74 → 145, 열방정식 n=8 723 → 945, y'=-3400y 436 → 687), 짧은 비강성 실행 +0.3~26%.

사라지는 것: 10, 1000, 1/2, 3.3, screen과 그 증분·통계·기준, NoBudgetForTrial, "탐침의 치명 오류가 풀이를 끝냄". 남는 것: 2배 간격(유일한 수, 관례), b를 정하는 연산 수 관례(2n³/3 등, dense kernel의 상한), 바꾸지 않는 드라이버 제어기 상수. 수 없는 규칙: 보폭 탐색 제외, 지배 비교, 남은 구간이 창보다 짧으면 pilot 생략, 한 방향 전환.

결정이 필요한 것: (1) pilot의 FD 열에서 치명 오류: 풀이 종료(권고) 또는 pilot만 버리고 계속, (2) Jacobian·JVP·band 제공 시 RODAS5P로 시작하는 규칙 유지(권고), (3) RODAS5P→DOPRI5 복귀는 별도 노드, (4) V03b 계약 "DOPRI5 구간 없음"을 작업량 경계로 교체, (5) 오늘 경로의 공개 이름 제거 또는 폐기 예정, (6) 선언 가격 옵션과 dense 연산 계수(보호 파일)는 나중. 승인 전에는 구현하지 않는다.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Doubling base of pilot times
remaining_hyperparameters.why: A geometric spacing keeps the pilot count logarithmic and the delay after an onset proportional to the work done (B2: at most A(t_s)+2b DOPRI5 attempts after onset). With base beta the delay is at most (beta-1)A(t_s) and there are log_beta pilots, so no scale-free optimum exists. Under B's simple model the optimum is 1.61, with worst ratio 2.38 against 2.53 at 2 (arithmetic checked), so the choice is weakly sensitive. 2 means the spend after a question equals the spend before it.

remaining_hyperparameters.name: Operation counts that fix b
remaining_hyperparameters.value: DOPRI5 52n per attempt; RODAS5P 2n^3/3 + 18n^2 + 128n per fresh FD attempt
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Needed to compare an LU-based attempt with explicit stages. 26 and 64 multiply-adds per component and 8 stages are tableau constants; 2n^3/3 per LU and 2n^2 per solve pair are textbook conventions. The operation unit binds for every n. The count is an upper bound of the zero-skipping LU, so b is conservative for sparse Jacobians stored dense. Exact counting needs a protected file (owner decision D6).

remaining_hyperparameters.value: 6 (7 first) per DOPRI5 attempt; n+9 (+2 non-autonomous) per fresh FD RODAS5P attempt
remaining_hyperparameters.why: Exact method counts (verified in fd.rs, rodas5p_fast.rs, problem.rs and against V03b). Dominated by the operation unit; recorded.

remaining_hyperparameters.why: Protected driver constants, not router parameters; changing them is not authorized. max_factor defines a growth-capped attempt in the located test, so no new number is added.

judge.evaluation_plan:
Pre-register after approval.

Arms:
- T: today's Auto at 80ba8388.
- N: FBP.
- References: D = Dopri5::solve and R = Rodas5p::solve with the same options.
- Exploratory, reported without a rule: N-prod (product threshold) and N-cont (D1 = continue).

Problems (FD unless stated):
- Stiff: P_scalar_fd; y'=-lambda*y for lambda in {2000, 3200, 3400}; P_heat_fd n=8 span 100; Robertson spans 40 and 1e5; HIRES; OREGO; Van der Pol mu=1000 span 1; flame delta in {1e-2, 1e-3, 1e-4}; heat n=64 FD span 10; k(t)=1e4 e^{-20t}+1 (report only).
- Non-stiff: oscillator spans 1, 10 and 1000; Lotka-Volterra; Lorenz; Arenstorf; Brusselator n=2; Van der Pol mu=1; damped oscillator omega=100; [[-1,1e3],[0,-2]]; Lorenz-96 n=40; pleiades.
- Callback, budget and declared cases: F2; N2 (fatal only at FD columns); P_fatal; P_blowup; P_mass; P_heat_dense, P_scalar_dense, P_heat_jvp and P_heat_banded; declared Stiff and Nonstiff; Robertson with max_steps 500 and 50.
- Tolerances: (1e-6, 1e-9) for all problems; also (1e-3, 1e-6) and (1e-8, 1e-11) for the non-stiff set and selected stiff cases.

Measures (counters only, no wall time):
- Charged callbacks and closure entries.
- Operations by one formula for all arms.
- Attempts.
- Pilots (count, verdict, H, costs) and handover time.
- Status and stop.
- Error at t1 against a reference.
- Final-state bits of 3 runs and the route digest.

Discriminators:
- E1: the geometric mean of cost(N)/cost(T) is below 1 in both callbacks and operations, and N's worst ratio to min(D, R) is below T's in each unit.
- E2: no case where T succeeds and N fails.
- E3: every run without a handover is bit-identical to D, with exactly the pilots' counters added and cost <= 2D; runs decided by a declared fact equal T.
- E4: attempts <= max_steps; exhaustion reports MaxStepsReached.
- E5: no callback before DOPRI5's first stage and none at t0 except DOPRI5 stages; every non-stage call is a RODAS5P FD column or time-derivative call from an accepted state; uncharged = 0.
- E6: determinism over 3 runs.
- E7: err(N) <= 3 max(err(D), err(R)).
- E8: F2 succeeds; P_fatal reports CallbackFailed(Rhs, 'sensor offline'); N2 behaves as D1 says.
- E9: the V03b work bounds hold (P_heat_fd <= 5890, P_scalar_fd <= 181818) and a handover is recorded.
- E10: pilots <= 1+floor(log2(A_D/b)) and pilot spend <= DOPRI5 spend.

Declared expected losses (not failures): P_scalar_fd, P_heat_fd, y'=-3400y and heat n=64 FD; short non-stiff runs lose +0.3 to 26% to lost pilots. The model predictions are registered as expectations without a rule.

Frozen decision: adopt N iff E1-E10 pass; otherwise today's route stays. A failure of E3, E4, E5, E6 or E10 refutes the unconditional properties. A failure of E1 refutes the economic claim. A failure of E2 blocks adoption.

Run with taskset -c 0-5,12-17 cargo +1.94.1 test --locked -j 4 --release -p vigilode, a node-owned CARGO_TARGET_DIR and failing-first logs.
